test_count: Bare test/it call sites and their .each/.only/.skip forms in .test/.spec files, parsed with the pinned Jest runtime parser. Unchanged starter files are separate from changed/new files. Parameterized sites count once. Parse failures are disclosed, not zero. Applied identically to original and replacement draws; not executed tests.
disclosure: Replacements for original arms and for the same-day rule and baseline arms ran on a later date than their source draws. Original runs used ten-draw blocks; the ablation interleaved arms, so drift contrasts mix date with schedule. Primary substitutes once and retains observed-draw denominators; sensitivity uses no replacements and counts original harness losses as failures with the frozen mutant denominator. Imputed losses are not observations. Paired task means, task-sorted 4000 resamples, seed 501; pooled ratios recomputed per resample. Nonsignificance is not equivalence.
